name: Andon: every tile kind
info:
A view with one tile of every kind, and a function node that sends to each of them.

Open the view "All tile kinds", import the .env of a view from the Andon configurator (https://andon.app/en/configurator) and deploy. Keep the template: the function node sends to exactly these tiles.

Below each tile, the function node lists every form that tile takes, as a node.send. The first one is sent every 30 s; uncomment another to try it. msg.topic is the tile ID.
